description: This file implements a noise reduction audio filter class 'NoisereduceFilter' using the 'noisereduce' library, designed for background noise suppression in audio streams within the Pipecat project. It includes methods for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data, with deprecation warnings indicating it will be removed in future versions.

classes.name: NoisereduceFilter
classes.description: A deprecated audio filter class that applies noise reduction using the 'noisereduce' library, with methods for initialization, control frame processing, and audio filtering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the NoisereduceFilter instance, setting default filtering state and sample rate, and issuing a deprecation warning.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for the filter based on the input transport's sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup actions when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Performs noise reduction on input audio bytes using spectral gating, returning filtered audio bytes.
